summary: Iter 27 full-stack test — BACKEND 7/7 PASS, FRONTEND all critical flows PASS. Verified /api/admin/uploads/video validator now accepts iOS MOV (contentType=video/quicktime + ftyp+qt magic bytes -> 200, returns contentType='video/quicktime'), Android/generic MP4 (contentType=application/octet-stream + ftyp+mp42 magic -> 200, returns contentType='video/mp4'), WebM (EBML magic 1A45DFA3 -> 200, returns contentType='video/webm'), rejects plain-text file with HTTP 400 and 'Unsupported video format' message, and requires admin auth (401 without token). All three real uploads reached Object Storage successfully — verified in follow-up run: returned public /api/uploads/... URLs plus size/contentType. ScheduleIn schema extension verified — POST /api/admin/schedule accepts coverImage + status fields; PATCH updates them via partial body.dict(exclude_unset=True); public GET /api/radio/schedule reflects both fields. Default status='upcoming' when omitted and isLive=false. FRONTEND: (a) Home /(tabs) TODAY'S SCHEDULE row renders seeded schedule slot with cover image background + LinearGradient overlay + LIVE NOW badge (LIVE dot + text), (b) admin user sees 'Manage' link next to TODAY'S SCHEDULE that routes to /admin/schedule, (c) empty-state text 'No slots scheduled yet.' is wired in code (lines 170-173 of (tabs)/index.tsx), (d) /admin/schedule form (opened via sched-add-btn) exposes sched-status-on-air / sched-status-upcoming / sched-status-off-air chips, sched-cover image picker (Ionic image icon + PICK FROM DEVICE / PASTE URL / CHOOSE IMAGE), and existing slots list shows coverImage thumbnail next to each row (verified visually — TEST_ITER27 Live Now Show row displays its 800px pexels cover thumbnail on the left column). No red-screen or console errors during any flow (only 1 known deprecation warning: pointerEvents prop — non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2131 _sniff_video_mime — correctly handles ISO base-media ftyp brand detection (qt vs mp4 family), EBML for webm, RIFF/AVI, MPEG-PS. Solid magic-byte coverage for the 5 major container families.

server.py:2180-2187 validator — Accept-if-EITHER logic (sniffed OR ext OR mime allowlist) is the correct fallback strategy for the iOS Photos picker case where contentType=application/octet-stream is normal. Good.

server.py:2190 final_ct precedence prefers sniffed > client-declared > 'video/mp4' fallback — this correctly rewrites ambiguous octet-stream uploads to the sniffed real container type before persisting to Mongo/uploads collection. Downstream video players will now get the correct MIME.

server.py:890-898 ScheduleIn — coverImage and status are Optional[str] with no Literal enum for status; consider Literal['on-air','upcoming','off-air'] to reject typos at the API layer. Not blocking; frontend already restricts via chips.
server.py:912 default status logic — 'on-air' when isLive else 'upcoming' is sane. Good.
server.py:924 PATCH uses body.dict(exclude_unset=True) — supports true partial updates for coverImage/status without wiping other fields.

app/admin/schedule.tsx:149 Switch onValueChange auto-syncs status field when isLive toggles (status='on-air' when live=true, resets 'on-air'->'upcoming' when live=false) — nice UX consistency between the two controls.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx:179-197 conditional rendering — when s.coverImage is set, padding is stripped and a full-bleed Image + LinearGradient (top 0.1 -> bottom 0.85 alpha) is rendered with LIVE NOW badge; when no coverImage, fallback to text-only card. Clean pattern, no layout jumps.
app/(tabs)/index.tsx:164 admin-gated 'Manage' link uses user?.role === 'admin' check — matches backend role field. Confirmed rendered in-browser after admin OTP verify.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (home LIVE NOW badge + cover image + admin Manage link, admin schedule form with status chips + cover picker + list thumbnails)

Frontend UI test seeded one 'TEST_ITER27 Live Now Show' slot via admin API and deleted it at end of run. Three ~20-byte fake video files with valid magic bytes were uploaded to Object Storage under /bb-fm-kigali/videos/{admin_id}/ during backend tests — these are the only residuals but they are gated behind admin auth and take ~90 bytes total; not worth cleaning up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For future iters, note the pytest xdist race: /app/backend/pytest.ini forces `-n auto --dist loadscope` which parallelizes across workers. If a module-scoped fixture calls /api/auth/otp/start followed by verify, running it in two workers will invalidate the first worker's OTP challenge (server-side single-use). Run with `-n 0` to force serial when your test needs a single admin session — this is what iter27 used. Test credentials unchanged: admin phone +250794230137 returns testCode 123456 (SMS_DEV_RETURN_CODE=true). ScheduleIn now supports coverImage (str URL) + status (str: 'on-air'|'upcoming'|'off-air'). Video upload endpoint /api/admin/uploads/video accepts multipart/form-data with `file` field; validator uses BOTH client-declared mime/ext AND magic-byte sniff (first 64 bytes). Video mime map: ftyp+qt->quicktime, ftyp+other->mp4, EBML 1A45DFA3->webm, RIFF+AVI->avi, 0000_01BA->mpeg. Testing tiny (20-byte) payloads with valid magic bytes is enough to exercise all branches; Object Storage accepts them without errors.
